# UIPadding

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIPadding")`

Insets its parent's content on each side (§2.2). Like `UIListLayout`, a modifier parented beside what it affects.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PaddingBottom` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | Scale is a fraction of the parent's own height. |
| `PaddingLeft` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | Scale is a fraction of the parent's own width. |
| `PaddingRight` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | Scale is a fraction of the parent's own width. |
| `PaddingTop` | `UDim` | `UDim.new()` | read/write | Scale is a fraction of the parent's own height. |
